description: NaMnH₃(CO₂)₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.40 Å) and three longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.23 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one H and two O atoms. The C-H bond length is 1.11 Å. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom.
